_readme: Static outlet transparency lookup table, keyed by registrable domain. 8849-entry dataset built from the full Media Bias/Fact Check (MBFC) rating database (8838 unique domains from a 10859-row MBFC export), merged with AllSides community ideology ratings for domains MBFC didn't rate, plus a handful of hand-curated entries with richer fields (parentCompany/founded/headquarters/monthlyReaders/ownershipDetail) where available. `ownershipType` is 'Unknown' for MBFC/AllSides-sourced entries since neither source classifies ownership structure - only the originally hand-curated entries have real ownership data. The 4 Philippine outlets (SMNI, Rappler, ABS-CBN News, GMA News) were seeded as illustrative placeholders for the thesis UI mockup's demo scenario; any of the four now showing an MBFC sourceNote have been superseded by a real MBFC rating, the rest remain unverified placeholders pending a proper Philippine media-monitoring source.

fields.domain: Registrable domain used to match the current tab's URL.
fields.name: Human-readable outlet name.
fields.ideology: One of: Extreme Left, Left, Center-Left, Center, Center-Right, Right, Extreme Right (per AllSides/MBFC methodology).
fields.factualReliability: One of: Very High, High, Mostly Factual, Mixed, Low, Very Low (per MBFC methodology), or null if not yet verified against MBFC (popup shows an 'Unknown' badge with neutral styling in that case).
fields.ownershipType: One of: Corporate Chain, Independent, State-Affiliated, Foundation-Funded, Religious Organization, Unknown.
fields.sourceNote: Short attribution for where the rating came from, shown directly in the popup.
fields.parentCompany: Optional. Parent/holding company name, shown in the Source tab.
fields.founded: Optional. Year founded (number), shown in the Source tab.
fields.headquarters: Optional. City, Country, shown in the Source tab.
fields.monthlyReaders: Optional. Approximate monthly audience as a short string (e.g. '12M'), shown in the Source tab.
fields.ownershipDetail: Optional. Longer freeform text shown when the user expands "Learn about ownership" in the popup; falls back to `sourceNote` if omitted.
fields.mbfcUrl: Link to the outlet's Media Bias/Fact Check review page (opened by the Source tab's 'Learn about ownership' button).
fields.country: Country of the outlet per MBFC.
fields.mediaType: Media type per MBFC (Newspaper, TV Station, Website, ...).
fields.ownershipSource: Present when ownership comes from data/ownership-curated.json rather than a dataset.
